title: Held-mouse recall-context decoding from processed astrocytic calcium

titles: Hippocampal astrocytic calcium sequences during learning and memory recall

scientific_question: Can a frozen predictor classify recall context for held mice from the selected astrocytic calcium windows, and how does its performance compare with behavior-only, amplitude and time-scrambled controls?
primary_outputs: Observed context A=0 or B=1 for each fixed30-second window. This is an experimental context label, not a ground-truth memory strength or causal astrocyte mechanism.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: Per-animal collection objects contain accepted_traces and Timestamps; the release also includes accepted-trace CSVs and original Cell_Traces CSVs. These are astrocytic/glial calcium measurements, not neuronal spikes.
recording_contract.labels: Habituation, fear conditioning, context A and context B sessions; per-mouse event_times_cxta/cxtb, freezing vectors and Anymaze behavior. Context is an experimental label; event definitions must be fixed before scientific scoring.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Figure3 reads Timestamps[:traces.shape[0]] and per-animal event times, with event-aligned odd/even analyses. Context and behavior exports provide matching animal/session filenames. Units/monotonicity and trace-event range checks remain execution gates.
recording_contract.biological_ids: archive README names astroF*/astroM* animals and hab/fc/cxta/cxtb sessions. Inspected Figure3 explicitly selects astroF3,F5,F6,F7,F9,F10,M3,M4,M5,M9,M10 (11 mice) for a particular analysis; this is not claimed to be the full archive cohort.
recording_contract.evidence: Four real-input ZIP directories, published checksums, author upstream-loading README and Figure3 source inspected. Exact collection, trace and event filenames are present; no data objects or traces loaded.

primary.name: equal_mouse_balanced_accuracy and equal_mouse_log_loss
primary.aggregation: Compute each metric within all20 windows of a held mouse, then average the seven mice equally; retain both directions separately (accuracy higher, log loss lower).
primary.rationale: Preserve both co-primary endpoints and all comparator differences. Choosing only favorable accuracy would hide calibration degradation; no combined scalar or parity threshold is justified.

secondary: All seven mouse-level balanced accuracies/log losses and signed candidate-minus-reference differences for every fixed comparator.
Report neural-only versus behavior-only and combined arms under matched access; a combined success cannot identify a neural contribution.
Source scorer predicts B at p≥0.5 and clips only the log calculation at1e-15; calibration/extreme-probability failures remain visible.

comparators.inputs: No observations beyond declared class prior.
comparators.procedure: Existing fixed constant comparator accompanies private grading; retains both co-primary values.

comparators.procedure: Existing fixed time_scrambled comparator; interpretation is constrained to its actual source transform and does not remove all state/selection confounding.
